Call to Artists: Monumental Public Art Sculpture

16 Oct 2026 The City of Orlando invites professional artists and artist teams to submit preliminary conceptual proposals for the design, fabrication, and installation of a permanent monumental sculpture for a new community park in the Lake Nona community, a 14.2-acre recreational destination located along Luminary Boulevard.

Hispanic Heritage Month Art Exhibit

16 Oct 2026 The arts are an intrinsic part of the Hispanic heritage and culture, for this reason, the City of Orlando hosted an Open Call for local artists interested in showcasing the richness of Latin American history and heritage through their art.
